Name: Josiah, Son of Zephaniah
Summary: Josiah, son of Zephaniah, was one of the exiles from Babylon who brought silver and gold to Jerusalem for the crowning of Joshua the high priest (Zechariah 6:10). He is NOT King Josiah of Judah, who lived two centuries earlier. Zechariah 6:14 names 'Hen the son of Zephaniah' in the same list, which may be the same man under a variant reading or the word for 'grace' — the entry keeps to the clear 6:10 identification.
KeyStory: Josiah son of Zephaniah, with Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, brought gifts from Babylon for the crown placed on Joshua's head.
LifeLesson: Josiah son of Zephaniah is a namesake warning: the famous king and this quiet exile share nothing but a name. Read the genealogy, not just the name.
